tsavo-est-2-giorni.title: Tsavo East
tsavo-est-2-giorni.description: An intense first encounter with Tsavo East’s red earth and wildlife.
itinerary: Depart Watamu or Malindi at 6:00, enter Tsavo East and enjoy a morning game drive. Lunch, afternoon safari and overnight at the lodge.

Breakfast at 5:30 and departure at 6:00. Morning game drive on the way out of the park (exit around 9:00-9:30), a short stop at the Galana River to see the crocodiles, then straight back to Watamu around 12:00. Lunch is not included: you have lunch at your own resort.

tsavo-est-taita-hills-3-giorni.title: Tsavo East + Taita Hills
tsavo-est-taita-hills-3-giorni.description: From Tsavo’s red earth to the intimate landscapes of Taita Hills.
itinerary: Depart at 6:00, enter Tsavo East, game drive, lunch and afternoon safari. Overnight at the lodge.
Morning game drive, breakfast and transfer to Taita Hills. Lunch, afternoon game drive and overnight. Optional paid night safari with a ranger.
Morning game drive, breakfast, lunch and return to Watamu or transfer to Mombasa airport.

tsavo-est-amboseli-3-giorni.title: Tsavo East + Amboseli
tsavo-est-amboseli-3-giorni.description: Elephants, open plains and two of Kenya’s most iconic parks.
itinerary: Depart at 6:00, enter Tsavo East, game drive, lunch and afternoon safari. Overnight at the lodge.
Morning game drive and transfer to Amboseli. Lunch, afternoon safari and overnight at camp.
Morning game drive, breakfast and lunch. Return to Watamu or transfer to Mombasa airport.

mara-nakuru-amboseli-5-giorni.title: Masai Mara, Nakuru & Amboseli
mara-nakuru-amboseli-5-giorni.description: A complete journey from Nairobi through savanna, lake and Kilimanjaro country.
itinerary: Depart Nairobi at 6:00 for Masai Mara. Lunch, afternoon game drive and overnight.
Morning and afternoon game drives in Masai Mara, lunch and a second night at lodge or camp.
Depart after the morning game drive for Lake Nakuru. Lunch, afternoon safari and overnight.
Breakfast at 6:00 and transfer only to Amboseli, with no morning game drive. Lunch, afternoon safari, an after-dinner performance by a group from the Masai tribe, and overnight.
Final game drive and breakfast, then return or transfer to Mombasa airport.

masai-mara-nakuru-amboseli-tsavo-est-6-g.title: Masai Mara, Nakuru, Amboseli & Tsavo East
masai-mara-nakuru-amboseli-tsavo-est-6-g.description: A grand journey through four Kenyan ecosystems.
itinerary: Depart at 6:00 for Masai Mara, lunch, afternoon game drive and overnight.
Morning and afternoon game drives in Masai Mara, lunch and a second night.
Transfer to Lake Nakuru, lunch, afternoon game drive and overnight.
Breakfast at 6:00 and transfer only to Amboseli, with no morning game drive. Lunch, afternoon safari, an after-dinner performance by a group from the Masai tribe, and overnight.
Morning game drive and transfer to Tsavo East. Lunch, afternoon safari and overnight.
Morning game drive, breakfast and lunch. Return to Watamu or Mombasa airport.

masai-mara-nakuru-amboseli-taita-hills-t.title: The complete Kenya journey
masai-mara-nakuru-amboseli-taita-hills-t.description: From the Mara’s big cats to Tsavo’s red earth, via Taita Hills.
itinerary: Depart at 6:00 for Masai Mara, lunch, afternoon game drive and overnight.
Morning and afternoon game drives in Masai Mara, lunch and a second night.
Transfer to Lake Nakuru, lunch, afternoon safari and overnight.
Breakfast at 6:00 and transfer only to Amboseli, with no morning game drive. Lunch, afternoon safari, an after-dinner performance by a group from the Masai tribe, and overnight.
Transfer to Taita Hills, lunch and afternoon game drive. Optional paid night safari with a ranger.
Morning game drive and transfer to Tsavo East. Lunch, afternoon safari and overnight.
Final game drive, breakfast and lunch. Return to Watamu or Mombasa airport.

safari-blu.title: Blue Safari
safari-blu.description: Snorkelling in Watamu Marine National Park, Garoda beach, lobster lunch on Sudi Island and return at 17:00.

isola-dell-amore.title: Love Island
isola-dell-amore.description: Reach the atoll on foot or by boat depending on the tide: a natural heart of white sand.

sardegna-due.title: Sardegna Due
sardegna-due.description: A day between the atoll and coral reef, with a shellfish lunch.

isola-di-robinson.title: Robinson Island
isola-di-robinson.description: An excursion to Che Shale, among red crabs, mangroves and coastal landscapes.

rovine-di-gede.title: Gede Ruins
rovine-di-gede.description: Forest-covered ruins among great baobabs and the curious local monkeys.

hells-kitchen-marafa.title: Hell’s Kitchen
hells-kitchen-marafa.description: Earth-sculpted forms and an unforgettable sunset in Marafa’s Hell’s Kitchen.

vera-africa.title: Real Africa
vera-africa.description: Swahili villages and time with local families. Guests may bring gifts, always respectfully and without rhetoric.

aperitivo-mida-creek.title: Sunset at Mida Creek
aperitivo-mida-creek.description: Sunset drinks among the mangroves at Lichthaus, Crab Shack or Prawn’s Lake.

masai-mara.title: Masai Mara National Reserve
masai-mara.description: Vast plains, iconic wildlife and game drives at the heart of the reserve.

amboseli.title: Amboseli National Park
amboseli.description: Open plains, elephant herds and views of Kilimanjaro.

lake-nakuru.title: Lake Nakuru National Park
lake-nakuru.description: A Rift Valley lake ecosystem rich in birdlife and terrestrial wildlife.

tsavo-est.title: Tsavo East National Park
tsavo-est.description: Known for red earth, elephants and immense horizons.

tsavo-ovest.title: Tsavo West National Park
tsavo-ovest.description: Hills, springs and volcanic landscapes in western Tsavo.

taita-hills.title: Taita Hills Wildlife Sanctuary
taita-hills.description: An intimate hilly sanctuary with wildlife and optional ranger-led night drives.

excluded: Drinks at meals and breakfast on departure day
bring: Summer clothing and warmer layers for evenings
